metadata.question: Did active fire detections in Sumatra and Borneo, Indonesia, increase in 2023 compared to 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS MODIS or VIIRS active fire detections (MCD14DL or VIIRS 375m) - Use "FIRMS/MODIS/MCD14DL" for MODIS active fires - Date: Compare 2022 (full year) vs 2023 (full year) - Location: Sumatra and Borneo islands in Indonesia 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed - we want to count fire detections - Filter by confidence if needed (high/nominal confidence) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If count is 0 or low number, that's valid data (B if 2023 ≤ 2022) - C1: If collection is empty for either year - C2: Not applicable for point data (fires are points) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If 2023 count > 2022 count - B: If 2023 count ≤ 2022 count ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Sumatra and Borneo, Indonesia const sumatra = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[95, 6], [95, -6], [106, -6], [106, 6]] ]); const borneo = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[108, 7], [108, -5], [120, -5], [120, 7]] ]); const region = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon([sumatra, borneo]); // 2. Data Acquisition - FIRMS Active Fires const fires2022 = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-12-31') .filterBounds(region); const fires2023 = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-12-31') .filterBounds(region); // Check if collections exist const count2022 = fires2022.size().getInfo(); const count2023 = fires2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images: ${count2022}`); console.log(`2023 Images: ${count2023}`); if (count2022 === 0 && count2023 === 0) { console.log('No fire data found for either year.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Try alternative: MODIS thermal anomalies const modis2022 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-12-31') .filterBounds(region) .select('FireMask'); const modis2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-12-31') .filterBounds(region) .select('FireMask'); const modisCount2022 = modis2022.size().getInfo(); const modisCount2023 = modis2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 MODIS Images: ${modisCount2022}`); console.log(`2023 MODIS Images: ${modisCount2023}`); if (modisCount2022 === 0 || modisCount2023 === 0) { console.log('Insufficient MODIS data.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Count fire pixels (FireMask > 7 indicates fire detection) const firePixels2022 = modis2022.map(img => img.gt(7)).sum(); const firePixels2023 = modis2023.map(img => img.gt(7)).sum(); // 4. Calculate total fire detections const stats2022 = firePixels2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2023 = firePixels2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const total2022 = stats2022.get('FireMask').getInfo(); const total2023 = stats2023.get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Fire Detections: ${total2022}`); console.log(`2023 Fire Detections: ${total2023}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (total2022 === null || total2023 === null || isNaN(total2022) || isNaN(total2023)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const increase = total2023 - total2022; const percentChange = ((increase / total2022) * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${increase} (${percentChange}%)`); if (total2023 > total2022) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
